title: Shinonome Akito — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Friend From Class B
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are.
Morning, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it? I'm not lending you my textbook.

rows.Speaker: Friend From Class B
rows.Line: No, it's not that. Also, cut me some slack, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Friend From Class B
rows.Line: Anyway, enough of that. Today's your birthday, right? Here's a sports drink to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You never miss a beat, huh? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Say what? It's your birthday, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, lemme get you something.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you're just gonna all get me drinks, then no thanks. I'd prefer chocolate, cough drops or lozenges, you know?

rows.Speaker: Friend From Class B
rows.Line: Akito's sweet tooth right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hold on, cough drops?!
I'd be laughing if I didn't know you sang.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Don't they sell molasses candy at the school store? Wanna just get those?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, lozenges.

rows.Speaker: Friends
rows.Line: Haha!
Lunch Break

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, be right there.
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You had quite a bit of candy on your desk just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, you saw that?
They're birthday presents from my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. I've been meaning to ask you something regarding that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. If you'd like, would you mind if we take a slight detour before we go over to Ken's place?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but why...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know any details, but they wanted me to ask how free you were...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Who's “they”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ohh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's definitely them...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Just one of them if I'm lucky, but both if I'm not. Either way, I've got a bad feeling about this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Toya, can I get a rain check on that? I kinda want to head over to Ken's place ASAP after school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? But, well...
Hehehe...

You're very sharp, Shinonome.
I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello, Kamishiro, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, Akito, how have you been?
It's been some time since we last spoke. I suppose not being in the same year has that effect.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, we don't want to bother you and disturb the peace...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for being so considerate of us, Tsukasa. As you can see, we've both been well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I did have a show ready just in case you weren't feeling all that well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, we'd love to...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you've been generous enough already! Really! Also, I really don't think the corridor's the best place for that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so...?
Regardless, I'm glad to see that you're both doing fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, Tsukasa, don't you have something to give him?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Give what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Here you are, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your birthday present from Rui and myself!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... You really didn't have to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our original plan was to give that to you after school, but Toya said that he has an urgent matter to attend to then, so we decided to do it now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we didn't want to take up too much of your time, which led to us pushing our schedule up a little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Plus, now seemed like the best time to surprise you with this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But this box...
It looks like a normal present...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It doesn't weigh much either. I'm not hearing anything when I shake it, but it's big enough to fit two or three cakes pretty easily...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. It is a bit of an “explosive” gift, but it's nothing dangerous. You have my word.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! How is that not dangerous?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you know what's inside this box, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. I guarantee that you will enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it's “explosive”, so how...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well... It may be fun to wait and open it with your friends later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But for now, we'll be off! Again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much for doing this, Tsukasa, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was nice of them, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But what am I supposed to do with this thing...?)
